response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile web/full-stack and systems developer with deep experience in TypeScript, Node.js, D, and some C/C++, but has no evident background in embedded Linux kernel work, network switch/security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF/SNMP), or LAN-switch firmware. Most critically, there is no indication of native-level Japanese proficiency, which is an explicit hard requirement for this role, and English is the only listed fluent language besides Romanian.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across many languages and domains
Demonstrated systems-level and low-latency programming experience (DLang, C/C++, async I/O)
Strong track record of ownership, mentoring, and technical leadership (staff/senior roles, workshops, open source)
concerns: No native-level Japanese language proficiency indicated, which is a required qualification
No demonstrated experience with Linux kernel investigation/modification or embedded LAN-switch firmware
No evidence of security-specific domain knowledge (MACsec, 802.1X, tamper detection, NETCONF/SNMP)

key_factors.factor: No embedded Linux kernel or switch firmware experience
